summary.infoText: PDF books are delivered after payment, while physical products can be shipped across Belarus and internationally.

payment.title: Cash on delivery
payment.short: You pay at the post office on pickup
payment.desc: We ship the printed book across Belarus cash on delivery or by card transfer — after confirming the order with our team. The digital edition is sent once we reach out and receive the transfer.

items.name: Belposhta · cash on delivery
items.note: Delivery to any branch in Belarus. Pay on pickup in cash or by card.

items.name: Card transfer
items.note: Transfer to our card after confirming the order with our team — a handy alternative to cash on delivery.

items.name: Pickup in Minsk
items.note: Collect the books at our pickup point in the city center.

items.title: Choose books
items.desc: Add everything you like to the cart and place your order.

items.title: Enter the address
items.desc: Enter a post office branch or home address — no payment on the site.

items.title: We pack the parcel
items.desc: We pack the books and ship within 1–2 business days.

items.title: Pay on pickup
items.desc: At the post office branch — in cash or by card.

items.q: What if I don't pick up the parcel?
items.a: No worries: if a parcel is unclaimed within 30 days, it returns to us. You only cover the return shipping if it happened without a valid reason.

items.q: Can I inspect the books on pickup?
items.a: Yes. At the post office you can open the parcel before paying, make sure everything is fine, and only then pay.

items.q: How long does the parcel take?
items.a: Usually 3–5 business days across Belarus. After dispatch we send a tracking number.
It depends on what you ordered — e-books, physical books, and made-to-order merch each work differently. See the full breakdown below.
